purpose: Assess ASVS V4 API and Web Service, including an SSRF in the partner webhook dispatcher and a WebSocket surface that only looks alive.
requiredInvariants: A coverage claim names the denominator it measured.
A dead surface is not given a FAIL for a defect that cannot occur, and the forward risk is stated instead.
A reference inside a test is not mistaken for a served API.
One blocker is treated the same way in every chapter that meets it.
FAIL is recorded and reported, never resolved by editing product logic.
No product logic, dependency, production, REG.RU, DNS or database change.
acceptance: V4.2.5 is FAIL, describing the SSRF precisely and linking it to the inline-body-type correction.
V4.1.1 states its denominator: seven raw response paths, seven declared content types.
V4.4.x are NOT_APPLICABLE via NO_RUNTIME_CALLER, with the forward risk of the orphaned client stated in the note.
V4.3.x do not mistake a graphql string inside a test for a served API.
V4.1.2 and V4.2.x carry the same edge blocker treatment as V12, not a new one.
All 16 V4 requirements are decided: 2 PASS, 2 FAIL, 6 not assessed, 6 justified non-applicable.
